question:
Which of the following is the correct match of the column-A with column-B?

 
 

 
 
Column-A (River)

 
 
 
Column-B (Place of Origin)

 
 
 

 
 
i.

 
 
 
Ganga 

 
 
 
a.

 
 
 
Amarkantak

 
 
 

 
 
ii.

 
 
 
Chenab

 
 
 
b.

 
 
 
Western Ghats near Mahabaleshwar

 
 
 

 
 
iii.

 
 
 
Narmada 

 
 
 
c.

 
 
 
Gangotri glacier

 
 
 

 
 
iv.

 
 
 
Krishna

 
 
 
d.

 
 
 
Spiti

options.text: i - c, ii - d, iii - a, iv - b
i - c, ii - a, iii - b, iv - d
i - d, ii - c, iii - b, iv - a
i - c, ii - d, iii - b, iv - a

solution:
The correct answer is **o**__**ption 1) i - c, ii - d, iii - a, iv - b**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Ganga**: The source of the Ganga river, also known as the Bhagirathi till it meets the Alaknanda at Devprayag, is the **Gangotri glacier** in Uttarakhand.
 
• **Chenab**: The Chenab River originates in the upper Himalayas in the **Spiti district** of Himachal Pradesh, India.
 
• **Narmada**: The Narmada River originates from the Maikal Hills of **Amarakaṇṭaka** located in the Anuppur district, Madhya Pradesh.
 
• **Krishna**: The Krishna River originates in the **Western Ghats**,** near the village of Mahabaleshwar** in Maharashtra.

Hence, i - c, ii - d, iii - a, iv - b is the correct pairing for rivers with their place of origin.
